title: Advanced Redstone Expansion
description: Advanced Redstone Expansion adds sleek, survival-balanced redstone blocks, wireless quantum channels, configurable timers, smart filtering hoppers, and optional omni-directional redstone dust output.
body:
Advanced Redstone Expansion is a Fabric mod designed for players who want more powerful, precise, and scalable redstone systems without breaking vanilla mechanics.

It adds practical engineering tools for survival worlds and multiplayer servers, enabling wireless networks, precision timing, smart item filtering, and enhanced redstone control — all while preserving vanilla compatibility and power levels.

Whether you're building compact contraptions, large-scale automation systems, or server-wide redstone networks, this mod expands what’s possible with redstone while keeping the experience intuitive and balanced.

Why Download Advanced Redstone Expansion?

⚡ Wireless Redstone Networking
Transmit redstone signals instantly across any distance — even across dimensions — using configurable channels with persistent server data.

🧠 Designed for Redstone Engineers
Every block is built for practical use in real contraptions, focusing on reliability, clarity, and precise control.

📊 Clear Visual Configuration
GUIs include 3D block previews and numeric readouts for timing and channels so you can configure systems quickly and accurately.

🌍 Multiplayer-Friendly
Persistent network channels and deterministic behavior make the mod ideal for servers and collaborative redstone builds.

🔧 Vanilla-Compatible Mechanics
All systems respect vanilla redstone rules, including power levels (0–15) and comparator behavior, ensuring compatibility with existing contraptions.

Included Blocks
Pulse Relay

Emits a short redstone pulse when triggered, useful for edge detection and signal control.

Quantum Transmitter

Sends a redstone signal to any matching Quantum Receiver on the same channel, regardless of distance or dimension.

Quantum Receiver

Receives wireless signals from transmitters on the same channel and outputs a redstone signal.

Timer

Generates configurable redstone pulses with precise tick timing.

Proximity Detector

Detects nearby players or entities and outputs a redstone signal.

Filter Hopper I–V

Advanced hopper variants that allow filtering 1 to 5 different item types, enabling compact and efficient sorting systems.

Key Features

Cross-dimensional wireless redstone channels

Persistent server-side network data

3D block previews inside configuration GUIs

Clear numeric timing and channel readouts

Filter hopper tiers supporting 1–5 item filters

Data-generated blockstates, models, recipes, loot tables, and language files

Optional Feature: Omni Redstone Dust

Advanced Redstone Expansion also adds an optional enhanced redstone dust mode.

When enabled:

Powered dust outputs strong and weak power in all directions

Redstone becomes more flexible for compact builds

Toggle per block:
Sneak + Right Click redstone dust to switch Omni Mode ON/OFF.

Vanilla power levels and comparator behavior remain unchanged.
